value.rationale: The source threshold is operationally important because single-use private information vanishes there while multi-use preprocessing can remain positive. The new result identifies the critical law of the single-use benchmark itself, including both the exact leading coefficient and the optimizer geometry. This explains why near-threshold single-use rates collapse much faster than the pooling width and turns a numerical boundary into a quantitative local phase-transition description.
